title: ATV Handlebar Grips – Anti-Skid Aluminum 22mm
descriptionHtml:
Better grip – better control

Worn or slippery grips make it hard to steer safely off-road. With poor grip, both the riding and the safety suffer.

Firm grip in aluminum

These handlebar grips are made of aluminum alloy with a non-slip grip. They fit 7/8 inch (22 mm) handlebars and give better control in all situations.

Features

  • Non-slip grip for better control
  • Durable aluminum alloy
  • Fits 7/8 inch (22 mm) handlebars
  • Easy to install
  • Great for ATVs, motorcycles and off-road vehicles

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
